chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl bin Ziyad, from Ja'far bin Muhammad, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

My father heard a man attaching himself to the House (Kaaba) and he was saying: 'O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad.' So my father said to him: 'O servant of Allah! Do not amputate it! Do not be unjust to us regarding our right! Say: O Allah! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the People of his Household.'

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ: The People of his Household (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.لَا تَبْتُرْهَا: Do not amputate/cut short it (referring to the invocation)

ai.seo_question: Why should one include the Ahl al-Bayt when sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Shia theological emphasis on the inseparable link between the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt in acts of worship, particularly supplication. Imam al-Baqir’s instruction to 'not cut it off' (la tabturha) underscores that omitting the Household from blessings is a form of injustice (zulm) against their divinely appointed status. This practice reinforces the concept of *Tawassul* through the Prophet’s family, a key element in Shia devotional life.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Al Qadah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Myasws fatherasws overheard a man attaching to the House (Kaaba) and he was saying, ‘O Allahazwj! Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww’. So myasws fatherasws said to me: ‘O servant of Allahazwj! Do not amputate it! Do not be unjust to usasws of ourasws rights! Say, ‘O Allahazwj! Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and the Peopleasws of hissaww Household’.
en.sarwar: 21. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from ibn al-Qaddah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

My father once heard a man, clinging to the Ka’bah, saying, ‘O Lord, grant al-Salat (favors) to Muhammad.’ My father then said to him, ‘O servant of Allah, do not shorten it that way. Do not do injustice to us in our rights. Say, “O Lord, grant al-Salat to Muhammad and his family.’”
